argv:
Billing flagged a workspace whose "issues used" meter reads lower than the number of open issues it actually has; at one point it even went negative. Support traced the timing to an admin archiving a whole project with the option to archive its issues as well. The audit-log entry for that project says it archived 12 issues, although only 9 of its issues were still open: the other 3 had been archived by hand weeks earlier. The compliance team also noticed that those 3 older issues now carry this week's date as their archive date, so the retention sweep will keep them for months longer than the plan promises.

Fix it so that archiving a project archives only the issues that were still live, leaves issues that were already archived exactly as they were (including when they were archived), reports the correct number of archived issues everywhere that number is used, and keeps the issues-used meter equal to a recount of live issues. Issues in other projects must not be affected.

This is a `fix` task: edit the code and stop. Do not write a summary and do not emit an ANSWER line.
